name: A - Sentiment & Surveys Watch
description: Sentiment-domain collector in the macro-monitoring swarm. Watches UMich Consumer Sentiment, Conference Board Consumer Confidence and the German Ifo Business Climate; logs prints to the Macro Monitor blackboard and alerts #hyper-asset-monitoring on new releases / material surprises.

scheduledInvocations.name: Release check — morning
scheduledInvocations.prompt:
Scheduled release check — follow your run cheatsheet memory and the Survey Release Checker skill (don't restate the calendar/sources here).
(1) DEDUP: read the blackboard Sentiment & Surveys section; note the latest logged date per report.
(2) GATE: run the skill `due`. If nothing is due, write ONLY the 'Last checked: <ts ET> - no new release' heartbeat line (replacing the previous one) and STOP — no fetching, no Slack, ~2 lines out.
(3) If a report is due: `fetch` that one, dedup; if genuinely new, append one row, update Current stance, and post a concise #hyper-asset-monitoring alert. Mark unverifiable figures 'unconfirmed' — never guess.
Heartbeat every run; Slack only on a new landing.
